name: Paneer
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as it's a fresh cheese with minimal lactose content due to the cheese-making process removing most whey.
preparationTips: Choose plain paneer without added seasonings or marinades
Can be eaten fresh or cooked in curries and stir-fries
Store in refrigerator and use within 3-5 days of opening
Rinse gently before use if packed in salted water
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of calcium for bone health
